function meshGrid(n,m,evaluate,colors=false,normalAt=null) {
  const positions=[], uvs=[], indices=[], rgb=[], normals=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=n;i++) for(let j=0;j<=m;j++) {
    const u=i/n, v=j/m, p=evaluate(u,v);
    positions.push(p.x,p.y,p.z);
    uvs.push(u,v);
    if(colors) rgb.push(p.color.r,p.color.g,p.color.b);
    if(normalAt) {
      const q=normalAt(u,v);
      normals.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
    }
  }
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++) for(let j=0;j<m;j++) {
    const a=i*(m+1)+j, b=a+m+1;
    indices.push(a,b,a+1,b,b+1,a+1);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setIndex(indices);
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs,2));
  if(colors) g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(rgb,3));
  if(normalAt) g.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals,3));
  else g.computeVertexNormals();
  return g;
}
function sweep(parent,name,points,radii,material,flatten=1,shadow=true) {
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
  const n=Math.max(22,points.length*8), m=24;
  const frames=path.computeFrenetFrames(n,false);
  const geometry=meshGrid(n,m,(u,v)=>{
    const i=Math.round(n*u), s=u*(radii.length-1), j=Math.min(radii.length-2,Math.floor(s));
    const r=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[j],radii[j+1],s-j);
    const a=-2*Math.PI*v;
    return path.getPointAt(u)
      .addScaledVector(frames.normals[i],r*Math.cos(a))
      .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[i],r*flatten*Math.sin(a));
  });
  return add(parent,name,geometry,material,V(0,0,0),shadow);
}

function profile(rows,y) {
  const i=Math.min(rows.length-2,Math.max(0,rows.findIndex(r=>r[0]>=y)-1));
  const a=rows[i],b=rows[i+1],before=rows[Math.max(i-1,0)],after=rows[Math.min(i+2,rows.length-1)];
  const h=b[0]-a[0], t=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((y-a[0])/h,0,1), t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  return a.slice(1).map((unused,k)=>{
    const j=k+1;
    const m0=(b[j]-before[j])/(b[0]-before[0]),m1=(after[j]-a[j])/(after[0]-a[0]);
    return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*a[j]+(t3-2*t2+t)*m0*h+(-2*t3+3*t2)*b[j]+(t3-t2)*m1*h;
  });

function makeCharacter(name,rows,cut,isRight) {

        Math.sin(19*y+15*a)*.009+Math.sin(8*y+6*a)*.016;

      const c=coat.clone().lerp(gold,frontShade).lerp(cream,1-smooth(.92,1.04,patch+mottling*1.1));

const paperUnder=mat(0xe6d8ba,{side:THREE.DoubleSide});
const binding=mat(0x67513e);
const sheetLine=mat(0x9b886b,{transparent:true,opacity:.38});
const openBook=group('open-notebook',desk);

const bookSpineFront=onPlane(94,229,tableY+.028);
const bookSpineBack=onPlane(65,205,tableY+.028);
function pagePosition(side,u,v,arch,offset=0) {
  const p=bookSpineFront.clone().lerp(bookSpineBack,v);
  const spread=side<0 ? 1.42 : 1.46;
  p.x+=side*(spread*u+.034*Math.sin(Math.PI*v)*u);
  p.z+=side*(-.47*u)+.09*u*Math.sin(Math.PI*v);
  p.y+=offset+arch*Math.sin(Math.PI*u)**.78*(.71+.29*v)+.012*u;
  return p;
}
function surfaceSheet(parent,name,fn,material) {
  return add(parent,name,meshGrid(25,19,fn),material);
}
function bookHalf(side) {
  const pages=group(side<0?'left-pages':'right-pages',openBook);
  const bend=side<0?.147:.170;
  surfaceSheet(pages,'board-cover',(u,v)=>pagePosition(side,u*1.035,v*1.018-.009,.013,-.020),
    new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x63503c,roughness:.87,side:THREE.DoubleSide}));
  surfaceSheet(pages,'bottom-leaf',(u,v)=>pagePosition(side,u,v,.024,.006),paperUnder);
  for(let layer=1;layer<=6;layer++) {
    const a=layer/6;
    surfaceSheet(pages,'paper-leaf-'+layer,(u,v)=>
      pagePosition(side,u*(1-.029*a),v,.025+(bend-.025)*a,.009+a*.009),layer===6?paper:paperUnder);
  }
  for(let j=0;j<4;j++) {
    const points=Array.from({length:11},(_,k)=>pagePosition(side,k/10,0,.023+j*.013,.007+j*.009));
    sweep(pages,'stacked-paper-edge-'+j,points,[.004,.008,.008,.004],j%2?pageEdge:paperUnder,1,false);
  }
}
bookHalf(-1);
bookHalf(1);
sweep(openBook,'center-binding',[bookSpineFront,bookSpineFront.clone().lerp(bookSpineBack,.5),bookSpineBack],
  [.015,.023,.012],binding,.78);

const rightBook=group('notebook-on-the-right',desk,onPlane(211,203,tableY));
rightBook.rotation.y=.29;
box(rightBook,'brown-cover',V(0,.015,0),[1.89,.033,1.17],cover,.035);
box(rightBook,'paper-block',V(-.013,.052,-.006),[1.83,.061,1.11],pageEdge,.035);
surfaceSheet(rightBook,'open-cream-sheet',(u,v)=>V((u-.5)*1.83,.086+.058*Math.exp(-u*9)*Math.sin(v*Math.PI/2)+.012*v,(v-.5)*1.11),paper);
for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
  const y=.040+i*.013;
  sweep(rightBook,'fine-page-edge-'+i,[V(-.88,y,.550),V(0,y,.551),V(.88,y,.550)],[.002,.003,.002],sheetLine,1,false);
}

function segment(parent,name,a,b,r1,r2,material,sides=12) {
  const d=b.clone().sub(a);
  const obj=add(parent,name,new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,d.length(),sides,1),material,a.clone().lerp(b,.5));
  obj.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,1,0),d.normalize());
}
const pencilWood=mat(0xd5af7e);
const graphite=mat(0x272921);
const metal=mat(0x9e9d88,{metalness:.35,roughness:.42});
function pencil(parent,name,tip,end,paint,r,band=false) {
  const g=group(name,parent,tip);
  const length=end.distanceTo(tip);
  g.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,1,0),end.clone().sub(tip).normalize());
  const tipLen=Math.min(.16,length*.18);
  segment(g,'graphite-point',V(0,0,0),V(0,tipLen*.29,0),r*.06,r*.34,graphite,8);
  segment(g,'sharpened-wood',V(0,tipLen*.29,0),V(0,tipLen,0),r*.34,r,pencilWood,6);
  segment(g,'hexagonal-shaft',V(0,tipLen,0),V(0,length-(band?.076:0),0),r,r,paint,6);
  if(band) segment(g,'metal-cap',V(0,length-.076,0),V(0,length,0),r,r,metal,10);
  return g;
}
const writingPencil=pencil(desk,'pencil-held-to-paper',at(50,213,1.91),at(21,168,1.48),mat(0x4b4b3f),.025,true);
const writingHand=left.root.getObjectByName('hand-holding-pencil');
scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
writingHand.attach(writingPencil);
pencil(desk,'ochre-pencil',onPlane(177,213,.49),onPlane(229,229,.49),mat(0xa97436),.023);
pencil(desk,'dark-brown-pencil',onPlane(188,213,.508),onPlane(238,222,.508),mat(0x634931),.025,true);
pencil(desk,'pencil-at-the-front-edge',onPlane(23,241,.491),onPlane(1,226,.491),mat(0x46463d),.028,true);

const characters=[left.root,right.root];
function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
